review_pass_1.evidence: Compared official syllabus and approved roadmap; checked Conklin 1905, Gilbert comparative embryology and ascidians, Sulston 1983, nematode founder and cell-death reviews, Le Douarin, lineage reporter and quantitative tracing reviews. Distinguished primary muscle versus all muscle, nuclei versus cells, direct reporter versus recombination memory, invariant versus autonomous, graft contribution versus induction, specification versus determination. Added dedicated source for 1090/131/959 count and labeled graph units; hypothetical examples explicitly identified.
